records.note: Authored anchor for the adalimumab (Humira) / rheumatoid arthritis / Cigna appeal case. Source is IP0652 (pharmacy Drug Coverage Policy, effective 05/01/2026), the document that contains BOTH the RA clinical criteria (§7.A: age >=18, one conventional synthetic DMARD >=3 months, rheumatologist) AND the preferred-product step-therapy determination for brand Humira (p.5 NOTE: 'requires the use of preferred products before approval of a requested non-preferred adalimumab product' + not-covered list naming Humira NDCs starting 83457). The parallel National Formulary policy cnf_428 (review 03/18/2026) carries the same RA clinical criteria but NO preferred/non-preferred language and treats Humira and biosimilars identically; the non-preferred gate lives only in the pharmacy IP0652 doc + its cross-referenced Preferred Specialty Management policy (PSM003/PSM013/PSM014, not downloaded — exception criteria are governed there).
